blocks.text: A letter from our founder
blocks.html: A letter from our founder

blocks.text: About Us
My name is Monagni. For years, I stood beside friends, colleagues, and strangers with fire in their eyes and sketches in their hands—only to watch that fire dim when they met reality.
blocks.html: My name is Monagni. For years, I stood beside friends, colleagues, and strangers with fire in their eyes and sketches in their hands—only to watch that fire dim when they met reality.

blocks.text: They'd approach factories with 50-unit orders. Laughter.
blocks.html: They'd approach factories with 50-unit orders. Laughter.

blocks.text: They'd beg for 100 pieces. "Come back when you have 500."
blocks.html: They'd beg for 100 pieces. "Come back when you have 500."

blocks.text: And the ones who compromised? They'd receive garments that looked nothing like their samples. Terrible communication. Zero accountability. And a mountain of inventory they couldn't sell.
blocks.html: And the ones who compromised? They'd receive garments that looked nothing like their samples. Terrible communication. Zero accountability. And a mountain of inventory they couldn't sell.

blocks.text: Here's the truth the industry won't tell you:
blocks.html: Here's the truth the industry won't tell you:

blocks.text: High MOQs aren't a sign of quality. They're a transfer of risk.
blocks.html: High MOQs aren't a sign of quality. They're a transfer of risk.

blocks.text: They push the burden onto you—the designer—while they collect their cheque. You're left sitting on boxes of unsold stock, praying you guessed right on sizes, colours, and trends. One wrong bet? Your brand is finished before it started.
blocks.html: They push the burden onto you—the designer—while they collect their cheque. You're left sitting on boxes of unsold stock, praying you guessed right on sizes, colours, and trends. One wrong bet? Your brand is finished before it started.

blocks.text: It felt unfair. It felt unnecessary. It felt broken.
blocks.html: It felt unfair. It felt unnecessary. It felt broken.

blocks.text: So I built Modafie differently.
blocks.html: So I built Modafie differently.

blocks.text: Here, your minimum order quantity doesn't determine your potential. It determines your freedom.
blocks.html: Here, your minimum order quantity doesn't determine your potential. It determines your freedom.

blocks.text: Start with 30 pieces. Test the market. See what sells. Gather feedback. Then reinvest.
blocks.html: Start with 30 pieces. Test the market. See what sells. Gather feedback. Then reinvest.

blocks.text: Sell out in a week? Great—we'll run your next 30. Or 300. Or 3,000.
blocks.html: Sell out in a week? Great—we'll run your next 30. Or 300. Or 3,000.

blocks.text: The model is simple:
blocks.html: The model is simple:

items.text: Low MOQ means low inventory risk
More collections means an excited audience that never gets bored
items.html: More collections means an excited audience that never gets bored

blocks.text: You're not guessing what your customers want. You're listening. Adapting. Growing. One small batch at a time.
blocks.html: You're not guessing what your customers want. You're listening. Adapting. Growing. One small batch at a time.

blocks.text: And because you can launch limited-edition drops every few weeks, your brand stays fresh. Your audience stays hungry. And you're never stuck with last season's mistakes.
blocks.html: And because you can launch limited-edition drops every few weeks, your brand stays fresh. Your audience stays hungry. And you're never stuck with last season's mistakes.

blocks.text: Yes, we offer 360° services—from the first sketch to the last shipment.
blocks.html: Yes, we offer 360° services—from the first sketch to the last shipment.

blocks.text: Yes, we maintain European standards that rival luxury houses.
blocks.html: Yes, we maintain European standards that rival luxury houses.

blocks.text: But here's what truly sets us apart:
blocks.html: But here's what truly sets us apart:

blocks.text: Whether you're producing your first 30 pieces or your 30,000th, you get the same attention. The same quality. The same partnership.
blocks.html: Whether you're producing your first 30 pieces or your 30,000th, you get the same attention. The same quality. The same partnership.

blocks.text: We don't have a "small client" table and a "big client" table. There's just one table. And you never graduate from it—you grow at it.
blocks.html: We don't have a "small client" table and a "big client" table. There's just one table. And you never graduate from it—you grow at it.

blocks.text: From the emerging designer testing their first drop to the established brand scaling their tenth collection, the experience is identical. The care is identical. The obsession with your success? Identical.
blocks.html: From the emerging designer testing their first drop to the established brand scaling their tenth collection, the experience is identical. The care is identical. The obsession with your success? Identical.

blocks.text: Because we believe something the old factories forgot:
blocks.html: Because we believe something the old factories forgot:

blocks.text: A brand that starts with 30 today could be the brand ordering 3,000 tomorrow. And we want to be there for both moments.
blocks.html: A brand that starts with 30 today could be the brand ordering 3,000 tomorrow. And we want to be there for both moments.

blocks.text: Cheers,

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions
What is the minimum order quantity at Modafie?

We accept orders from as few as 30 pieces per style. This makes us ideal for emerging brands, designers testing new collections, or startups who want to produce small runs without large factory minimums.
blocks.html: We accept orders from as few as 30 pieces per style. This makes us ideal for emerging brands, designers testing new collections, or startups who want to produce small runs without large factory minimums.

blocks.text: Where is Modafie located?
Modafie is based in Europe. We produce to EU quality standards and ship internationally.
blocks.html: Modafie is based in Europe. We produce to EU quality standards and ship internationally.

blocks.text: What services does Modafie offer?
We provide end-to-end clothing manufacturing including: design mockups, tech pack creation, sample making, bulk production, custom tags and labeling, packaging, shipping, and product photography.
blocks.html: We provide end-to-end clothing manufacturing including: design mockups, tech pack creation, sample making, bulk production, custom tags and labeling, packaging, shipping, and product photography.

blocks.text: Can Modafie help with tech packs?
Yes. We create professional tech packs covering measurements, materials, stitching, trims, and construction details so your sample is made correctly the first time.
blocks.html: Yes. We create professional tech packs covering measurements, materials, stitching, trims, and construction details so your sample is made correctly the first time.

blocks.text: How long does sampling take?
Sampling typically takes 3 to 4 weeks from tech pack approval.
blocks.html: Sampling typically takes 3 to 4 weeks from tech pack approval.

blocks.text: Does Modafie work with sustainable fabrics?
Yes. We have a unique collection of sustainable exotic fabrics made from lotus, bamboo, aloe vera, eucalyptus, banana, and rose fibers.
blocks.html: Yes. We have a unique collection of sustainable exotic fabrics made from lotus, bamboo, aloe vera, eucalyptus, banana, and rose fibers.
